violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: The mechanical ware washing machine is not sanitizing properly with a sanitizer concentration of 0 PPM chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. Discontinue using the ware washing machine until it is properly sanitizing at 50 parts per million chlorine. Sanitize all equipment and utensils in the three compartment sink until the machine is serviced and working properly.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) the warewashing machine was not working properly and not sanitizing equipment utensils. The sanitizer bottle was empty however, even after replacing the bottle machine was still not sanitizing. 2) The upright freezer was leaking water or condensation. There were basins underneath the front of the refrigerator catching leaking fluid.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. 1. Have the dish machine serviced so that it is properly sanitizing all equipment and utensils. Correct within 10 days. A follow up is required for this. Instead of a site visit the PIC could email the EHS a copy of the repair receipt as proof of the unit being fixed. 2. Have the freezer serviced to address and correct the leaking. Correct the freezer leaking issue as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. 3 vat sink set up until dish machine can be repaired.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: the dish machine is unable to achieve a minimum chlorine concentration of 50 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2.
